cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
feats=[c for c in df.columns if c!='outcome']
others=[x for x in feats if x!='bmi']
df=df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
keep=[]
for _,g in df.groupby(others+['outcome'], sort=False):
    bmis=[]
    for i,row in g.iterrows():
        if all(abs(row.bmi-b)>=0.5 for b in bmis):
            keep.append(i); bmis.append(row.bmi)
clean=df.loc[sorted(keep)].reset_index(drop=True)
print('before',len(df),'after',len(clean))
print('removed by near-dup:', len(df)-len(clean))
print('pedigree-only near dup check:', clean.duplicated(subset=[c for c in feats if c!='diabetes_pedigree']).sum())
print(clean.outcome.value_counts())
clean.to_pickle('/tmp/clean.pkl')
"

import pandas as pd
c=pd.read_pickle('/tmp/clean.pkl')
feats=[x for x in c.columns if x not in ('outcome','diabetes_pedigree')]
keep=[]
for _,g in c.groupby(feats+['outcome'], sort=False):
    ps=[]
    for i,row in g.iterrows():
        if all(abs(row.diabetes_pedigree-p)>=0.01 for p in ps):
            keep.append(i); ps.append(row.diabetes_pedigree)
final=c.loc[sorted(keep)].reset_index(drop=True)
print(len(c), '->', len(final))
final.to_pickle('/tmp/final.pkl')
